sources.note: The 33 tasbih + 33 tahmid + 33 takbir sequence is completed to 100 with this tahlil once. Existing salah_tahlil is a separate, longer supplication (Bukhari 844/Muslim 593), so give this final phrase its own stable ID.

additions.title: Completing the hundred after prayer
additions.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
additions.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
additions.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. Sovereignty and praise belong to Him, and He has power over all things.
additions.instruction: After SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 33 times, say this once to complete one hundred.

salah_tasbih_tahlil_final.instruction: بعد قول سبحان الله ٣٣ مرة، والحمد لله ٣٣ مرة، والله أكبر ٣٣ مرة، يُقال هذا الذكر مرة واحدة لإتمام المائة.

salah_tasbih_tahlil_final.translation: Tidak ada tuhan selain Allah semata, tanpa sekutu bagi-Nya. Milik-Nya segala kerajaan dan segala pujian, dan Dia Mahakuasa atas segala sesuatu.
salah_tasbih_tahlil_final.instruction: Setelah membaca SubhanAllah 33 kali, Alhamdulillah 33 kali, dan Allahu Akbar 33 kali, bacalah zikir ini sekali untuk melengkapi seratus.
